name: Financial Instrument 48 Choice
definition: Choice to specific an instrument of type ISIN, LEI or Index.

ISIN.name: ISIN
ISIN.definition: Identifies the financial instrument using an ISIN.

LEI.name: LEI
LEI.definition: The LEI code of the issuer where the instrument is referring to an issuer rather than one single instrument.

Index.name: Index
Index.definition: Index on which the financial instrument is based.
